verdict.rationale: Retell's docs describe a built-in knowledge base where agents retrieve from crawled websites or uploaded documents, and Conductor can inspect KB sources and indexing status, showing this is a first-class, integrated RAG feature rather than a bolt-on. AI QA also scores 'knowledge base accuracy' per call, reinforcing that grounding is a core, monitored capability. Missing for 10: a dedicated deep-dive documentation page on knowledge base setup/retrieval mechanics and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of RAG answer quality.
